body: I'm an AI student at Information Technology University in Lahore. Most of my work sits where machine learning meets real products: a facial-recognition attendance system packaged for a gym SaaS, a RAG backend deployed on Hugging Face Spaces, and predictive models inside a production ranking pipeline.

Right now I'm an AI Engineer Intern at SyntekAI, working on computer vision and IoT for NeuroBin, a smart waste-sorting bin. Before that I spent a summer at FlyRankAI, where I raised classification precision from 71% to 89%.

I also build mobile and web apps in Flutter, from a Play Store expense tracker to a real-time jobs marketplace, and I keep my C++ and data-structures fundamentals sharp on LeetCode and with from-scratch projects.

projects.title: FlyRank ranking pipeline
projects.problem: FlyRank's ranking pipeline needed a reliable way to flag declining content without drowning reviewers in false positives.
projects.approach: Built and tuned four predictive models (Logistic Regression and Random Forest) to flag declining content. Cleaned and engineered features across 12,000+ content records, and shipped weekly model iterations that senior engineers reviewed.

outcome.label: lower false-positive rate across 5 review cycles

projects.title: Facial-Recognition Attendance
projects.problem: Gyms and classes lose time and accuracy on manual sign-in sheets.
projects.approach: A multi-module attendance system that captures faces with OpenCV, turns them into InsightFace embeddings, and matches them against a ChromaDB vector store. It is packaged as Windows executables with PyInstaller, with Firebase Auth and Firestore-based subscription gating for a gym SaaS product. A sibling project, Auto-Registration Facial Attendance, enrols new faces automatically so nobody has to be registered by hand.

projects.title: RAG Physics Tutor
projects.problem: Students need physics answers grounded in course material, not confident guesses from a general-purpose model.
projects.approach: A retrieval-augmented generation backend: SentenceTransformer embeddings, ChromaDB retrieval, and LLM answer generation behind a FastAPI service. Deployed on Hugging Face Spaces, with Firebase Auth and Redis-based rate limiting to secure and scale the API.

projects.title: Gymora
projects.problem: Gym member attendance relies on paper or manual sign-in, which is slow and easy to get wrong.
projects.approach: A gym management app in Flutter, deployed on both mobile and web through Firebase Hosting. QR check-in replaces traditional sign-in, and role-based authentication separates gym-owner and client access.

projects.title: Hazir App
projects.problem: Finding a barber, plumber, or other local provider means calling around, with no idea who is available right now.
projects.approach: An 'Uber for blue-collar work' in Flutter that shows which local jobs and service providers are available in real time. Includes booking, live queue visibility, provider profiles, and provider management, all synced through Firebase.

projects.title: CashMitra
projects.problem: Tracking everyday spending usually needs an account and a connection, which puts people off.
projects.approach: An expense tracker in Flutter with category breakdowns and local data persistence, so it works fully on the device. Published on Google Play.

projects.title: ML Algorithms from Scratch
projects.problem: Calling a library hides what gradient descent and threshold tuning actually do.
projects.approach: Linear and Logistic Regression implemented from scratch in NumPy, including gradient descent, k-fold cross-validation, and threshold tuning, then benchmarked against scikit-learn.

projects.title: ABDKitaab
projects.problem: I wanted to understand how a version-control tool tracks history, not just use one.
projects.approach: A mini Git clone in C++ built from scratch with linked lists and hash maps to track file history and generate diffs.
